# fundamental-analysis

> Zero-dependency TypeScript/JavaScript library that turns financial-statement numbers into valuation, profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency and distress-risk metrics (P/E, PEG, EV/EBITDA, ROE, ROIC, current ratio, net debt/EBITDA, Altman Z and Z'', Piotroski F-Score, DCF, Graham number, intrinsic value), each with an optional plain-English rating. Inputs that cannot give an honest answer return null, never NaN. Open source under the MIT licence.

Maintained by Boffin Coders (https://boffincoders.com), who design and build websites, web applications and mobile apps, and run their SEO, for businesses and agencies.

## Docs

- [Overview and playground](https://boffincoders.github.io/fundamental-analysis/): what the library does, code samples, live calculator
- [Guide and API reference](https://boffincoders.github.io/fundamental-analysis/api-docs/): installation, analyzeCompany, categorical analyzers, batch screening, growth trends, input conventions
- [Try it on real companies](https://boffincoders.github.io/fundamental-analysis/try/): 20 US companies analysed live from SEC EDGAR filings, with a rule-based verdict (not financial advice)
- [Metric pages](https://boffincoders.github.io/fundamental-analysis/metrics/pe/): one page per metric with formula, interpretation and calculator; full list in the sitemap

## Package

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/fundamental-analysis (install: npm install fundamental-analysis)
- Source: https://github.com/boffincoders/fundamental-analysis
- Changelog: https://github.com/boffincoders/fundamental-analysis/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- Formerly published as finance-calculator-pro

## Conventions

- Rates are decimals (0.15 = 15 %); amounts in any one currency per snapshot
- null means "not meaningful" (missing input, zero denominator, or a ratio that makes no sense)
- Ratings use generic, sector-blind rules of thumb and are not investment advice
